name: Chaat Elote
menu_role: CHOTA — vegetarian shareable (approved 12-dish test menu #2; not Core 5)
cooking_method: Char corn on a grill/comal with ghee, toss while hot with raita-crema, cheese, chaat masala, lime and chile

portion.construction: roadside-style layered cup; exact lime-salt-heat balance is the identity test

lines.prep: fresh cut or thawed, dried well
added at the last second for crunch

steps: Pat kernels dry; char in a hot dry pan or on the comal in small batches with ghee until browned in spots.
Toss hot with salt, raita-crema, half the cheese, chaat masala, chile, lime juice; taste for salt-lime-heat balance.
Serve in a cup topped with the remaining cheese, cilantro and sev; lime wedge.

critical_parameters.char: browned spots without drying the corn out

plating: Small bowl or paper-lined cup, kernels glossy with crema, cheese crumbs, sev crown, cilantro, lime wedge.
equipment: Pan or tray for char batches
food_safety: Cooked corn held hot at or above 57 °C or cooled per policy; cold dairy toppings at or below 5 °C.
Check cotija rennet source; check sev oil/fryer cross-contact.

pairing.hypothesis: Lime, chaat tang and mango-hop aroma echo; juicy body softens chile.
pairing.risk: Hop bitterness plus chaat salt and chile.
